behavior_constraints: Add a read-only `impact` subcommand that reports transitive descendants of `--job` through `deps`.
Descendants are jobs with a non-empty dependency path back to the target; the target itself is not included.
Default `--format text` emits descendants one per line in level-major byte-wise order, each `\n`-terminated; no descendants emits zero stdout bytes.
`--format json` emits a compact JSON array of descendant names in level-major byte-wise order followed by one `\n`; no descendants emits `[]\n`.
`--spec` missing exits 2 with non-empty stderr `error: ...` and empty stdout.
`--job` missing exits 2 with stderr `error: --job required\n` and empty stdout.
`--job` not in spec exits 2 with stderr `error: unknown_job: <name>\n` and empty stdout.
Invalid `--format` exits 2 with stderr `error: bad --format\n` and empty stdout.
`impact` must not support `--only`; any other flag or positional argument exits 2 with non-empty stderr and empty stdout.
Invalid spec exits 2 with stderr `error: <code>: <message>\n` using existing validation codes.
entities.summary: Add a read-only `impact` subcommand that validates a spec and prints the transitive descendants of a target job in text or JSON with the same error and walk-order semantics as other read-only subcommands.

instruction_head:
# jobforge impact

Add a new subcommand `impact` that reports the transitive **descendants**
of a given job — i.e., the set of jobs that transitively depend on the
target through `deps`.

All existing behavior is unchanged.

## New subcommand: `jobforge impact --spec <path> --job <name> [--format text|json]`

Validates the spec (same error contract as the other subcommands).
